text:
Maria: Noticing p99 latency spikes on FIFO nodes under sustained long-context runs (20k+ tokens). Spikes line up with heavy pager activity and lots of evict->reinsert churn.

Aj: Can you share repro steps & logs?

Maria: Repro: `./stress_repro --scenario long_context --seq 20000 --clients 80 --kv-cap 12GB --evict fifo`
Log snip:
```
[2026-03-17T09:14:02Z] pager: evict slab=42 -> victim=0x7f8a1c
[2026-03-17T09:14:02Z] kv: reinsert key=K12345 after eviction (age=3)
[2026-03-17T09:14:02Z] pager: page-in addr=0x7f8a2 async took=48ms
[2026-03-17T09:14:02Z] rpc: request latency p99=360ms
```

Leo: Reinsert after eviction looks suspicious. Could be handoff race: FIFO expects single-threaded transfer but our pager can reschedule slabs -> duplicates and tombstones.

Hana: Profiling: flamegraph https://perf.redwood/graph/3912
Hot path: `kv::try_reinsert()` under FIFO calls `pager::mark_evicted()` then immediately `kv::insert()` without an atomic check. Under concurrency we see duplicated short-lived entries and increased pager work -> page thrash.

Aj: That extra CPU + IO explains p99. Any quick fixes tested?

Maria: I tried a hybrid policy fallback: `--evict-policy hybrid` plus env `KV_REINSERT_DEDUPE=1` which enabled an atomic CAS guard. p99 dropped 360ms -> 90ms in our canary runs. Memory drift reduced.

sre-bot: Canary deployed hybrid policy to prod-canary at 2026-03-17T10:30Z.

Leo: Short term: land CAS guard + unit test. Mid term: add invariant checks in FIFO handoff path and a reclaimer that compacts tombstones more aggressively.

Hana: I'll add tracing IDs to pager evict/reinsert pairs (`evict_id`) so we can follow handoffs across threads. Also adding `pager.eviction_handoff_latency_ms` metric.

Aj: Also add a CI stress e2e that runs multi-threaded pager + long-context workload to reproduce the race.

Maria: Filed incident INC-2026-042 and documented mitigation steps. Monitoring `kv.reinserts.dedupe_rate` and `pager.eviction_handoff_latency_ms` now.

Leo: PR incoming for CAS guard + tests. Tagging @Hana for instrumentation review.

Hana: Adding an e2e that toggles FIFO/LRU/hybrid under load and asserts no reinserts > 1% of inserts within 1m. Will push to CI flaky-slow bucket.

Maria: Closing loop for now. Hotfix on canary for 24h. If p99 resurfaces we'll revert FIFO to LRU by default for long-context workloads. :eyes:
